edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: The hypothesized route is altered gut permeability and immune priming to bovine proteins in genetically susceptible infants, though the evidence remains unsettled.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2020 Verduci cohort in Front Nutr, which ties early cow's-milk introduction to type 1 diabetes in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: This is a contested edge. Exposure measurement, confounding, and publication-era effects all matter, so confidence should stay low until cleaner data accumulate.
